⌈The LdCom Low Proxy shall provide in its LdComUserModuleCnf containers the
LdComUserCbkHandleId values for the configured LdComUserIPdus, according to
its internal implementation requirements (e.g. to address the LdCom Low Proxy’s
data structures).⌋
The implementation of the LdCom Low Proxy may provide some basic infrastructure
for the LdCom High Proxy in order to be operational. Such generic infrastructure
services (including the access to LdCom APIs or the callbacks) can be linked between
Application Software Cluster and Host Software Clusters by means of
a LdCom base socket.
